buildRevisionComparison.reason: Initial local dist was a zero-revision credential-free fixture; during this review the runtime worker rebuilt with the exact source revision. Final comparison now uses that exact-revision local dist. The generated src/data/build-revision.json is not included among the 69 pinned source inventory files; all 69 tracked files are compared without exceptions. The generated file is checked separately and its complete value must be the source commit. It is build-generated, not a public JSON endpoint. If a zero fixture is used, only the exact revision meta may be substituted. Actual hosted revision is independently checked on all 8 routes plus 404; no manuscript, asset or other metadata is excluded.
